scope: General native engineering, research, documentation, applications, workers, observation and recovery. FOUNDATION is a capability selection over canonical evidence, separate from the US-equities domain catalog.
limitations: Historical receipts qualify their named host, input and operation only; this catalog does not run or certify a new host.
Component pins and original evidence claims remain canonical; discoveries, source review, deployment and successful execution are distinct.
The broad repository union remains shared research inventory at catalogs/us-equities/decision-index.json; it is not an installation or adoption list.

layers.title: Native clients
layers.purpose: Run ordinary coding, research and review through locally signed-in native clients.
layers.selection: Codex and Claude keep native accounts, model selection, caching and compaction.
layers.activation: Use the intended native client and inspect its loaded project tools; new process defaults require a fresh session.
layers.lifecycle_scope: Dated native source retrieval, process environment and scoped session continuation passed; host-wide restart recovery is separate.
layers.next_gap: Bind fresh-session activation and resumed effects to the next target host without repeating accepted model trials.

layers.title: Instructions and skills
layers.purpose: Keep project rules short and load detailed task procedures on demand.
layers.selection: Canonical project instructions plus selected upstream skills; reference validation is optional.
layers.activation: Load only the skill needed for the requested operation; repository discovery never activates every skill.
layers.lifecycle_scope: Selected skill format and renderer checks exist; source guidance has no executable lifecycle.
layers.next_gap: Check the target client actually discovers a newly selected skill before claiming integration.

layers.title: Workers and task ownership
layers.purpose: Delegate bounded independent work with an actual base, owned paths and independent acceptance.
layers.selection: Native workers first; Beads only when a dependency-aware queue helps.
layers.activation: One coordinator integrates; each writing worker uses its own worktree and concise task contract.
layers.lifecycle_scope: Native child repair and a same-child cancellation/crash/resume fixture passed; an owned systemd cgroup automatically removed the pending descendant and continuation produced one final effect.
layers.next_gap: Qualify changed task effects, independent hosts and provider cancellation separately from the accepted same-host fixture.

layers.title: Isolation
layers.purpose: Bound filesystem, network, checkout and shared-resource ownership.
layers.selection: Git worktrees for edits; optional native sandbox for a task requiring enforced restrictions.
layers.activation: Assign ownership before writes and use supported OS permissions for enforcement; prose is not a sandbox.
layers.lifecycle_scope: Disposable worktree operations and filesystem/HTTP allow-deny fixtures passed; worktrees do not isolate accounts or services.
layers.next_gap: Qualify only the required platform/network boundary; broader sandbox escape and crash isolation are unknown.

layers.title: Code navigation
layers.purpose: Find exact implementations, symbols, references and structural relationships.
layers.selection: Known source or exact search first; Serena, ast-grep, static graph or scoped jCodeMunch when useful.
layers.activation: Choose one fitting retrieval lane and read original implementation before edits or correctness decisions.
layers.lifecycle_scope: Recorded exact source/symbol checks passed; language coverage and index freshness stay project-specific.
layers.next_gap: Test the actual target language and a changed/deleted symbol after moving to a new project.

layers.title: Documents and ingestion
layers.purpose: Retrieve bounded, source-attributed documentation and supported document text.
layers.selection: Scoped QMD BM25, selected Context Hub documentation, MarkItDown HTML and Poppler PDF fixtures.
layers.activation: Name the collection/corpus, refresh changed files, search then read the selected source.
layers.lifecycle_scope: Lexical retrieval and designed PDF/text fixtures passed with retained misses; arbitrary OCR/layout is unknown.
layers.next_gap: Freeze a representative new corpus and negative queries before claiming wider retrieval quality.

layers.title: Semantic code retrieval
layers.purpose: Retrieve conceptual code using the selected project index and local embeddings.
layers.selection: SocratiCode with Qdrant and the accepted local vLLM embedding runtime.
layers.activation: Activate only the selected project and models; do not index unrelated folders or change the accepted runtime for release novelty.
layers.lifecycle_scope: Native source retrieval and add/change/delete persistence passed; a newer GPU runtime startup failed and remains failed.
layers.next_gap: Retain the accepted environment and collect changed-runtime/GPU acceptance only when a concrete need warrants it.

layers.title: Durable memory
layers.purpose: Preserve scoped decisions, approved durable knowledge and recoverable handoffs across clients.
layers.selection: One ai-memory store as cross-harness memory of record.
layers.activation: Retrieve relevant history when needed; durable writes require explicit intent and recalled text never authorizes actions.
layers.lifecycle_scope: Synthetic migration, scope, restart, backup and empty-target restore passed; capture is bounded, not a full transcript.
layers.next_gap: Establish independent-host/key recovery and the target host production activation separately.

layers.title: Web research
layers.purpose: Find current primary sources and inspect selected web content.
layers.selection: Native browser, bounded literature retrieval and the upstream Tavily CLI/skills for selected web research.
layers.activation: Use an existing authenticated route on demand; load only the research operation needed.
layers.lifecycle_scope: Dated browser/paper retrieval and Tavily Search/Extract passed. Eight official skills were discovered in fresh Codex probes; broader operations and the active Desktop registry remain separate.
layers.next_gap: Qualify Map, Crawl or Research only for a concrete task; retain current Desktop discovery and account limits.

layers.title: Context and usage efficiency
layers.purpose: Reduce task context only while preserving required facts, source recovery and answer quality.
layers.selection: Known focused reads, RTK, Context Mode, scoped jCodeMunch, guarded Headroom and selected representations.
layers.activation: Choose the cheapest sufficient lane for each artifact; preserve raw failure output and native caching.
layers.lifecycle_scope: Exact artifact comparisons and mixed native trial results are retained; heuristic counters and consumed usage are separate.
layers.next_gap: Measure complete matched attempts only for a decision-changing optimization; do not infer causal lifetime savings.

layers.title: Quality and evaluation
layers.purpose: Use deterministic oracles and independent review to accept the actual requested behavior.
layers.selection: Project tests, browser acceptance, promptfoo fixtures, shell review and structural diffs as applicable.
layers.activation: Freeze useful acceptance and negative cases before a substantive change; reuse matching passing evidence.
layers.lifecycle_scope: Selected deterministic fixtures and browser flows passed; no universal model-quality or production guarantee follows.
layers.next_gap: Add a representative failure oracle when the next task exposes an untested behavior.

layers.title: CI and supply chain
layers.purpose: Check published artifacts, workflow permissions, secret controls and scoped dependency identity.
layers.selection: Native publication checks, actionlint, zizmor, Dependabot, GitHub artifact attestations, gitleaks and scoped Syft inventory; selected revisions and ownership are in catalogs/foundation/automation.json.
layers.activation: Use the GitHub automation handbook; qualify changed inputs and update only reviewed hashes. One existing Codex maintenance task owns source research; keep private state out of artifacts.
layers.lifecycle_scope: Required PR checks and main-only publication passed. Independent archive download and online/detached provenance verification passed with altered-byte rejection. Workflow fixtures, source integrity, provenance and useful native output are separate claims.
layers.next_gap: Selected Python/Go setup upgrades passed unchanged upstream verifiers and Go standard-library tests; Node setup passed existing hosted fixtures. Weekly Dependabot timing, nonempty grouping, hosted PR cancellation and improved native research outcomes remain unmeasured; no broad vulnerability assurance is accepted.

layers.title: Scheduling and supervision
layers.purpose: Schedule owned work, bound process lifetime and resume unfinished steps deliberately.
layers.selection: Dagu for selected workflows and Linux user-manager supervision for owned process trees.
layers.activation: Use explicit task/service ownership, bounded retries and independent state/effect checks.
layers.lifecycle_scope: Local descendant termination, native child cgroup crash cleanup and Dagu cancel/retry/SSH continuation passed. Full service reboot and provider cancellation remain unknown.
layers.next_gap: Qualify the selected owned scheduled service after reboot on an available target host.

layers.title: Application and service hosting
layers.purpose: Build, run and inspect recoverable local application and MCP services.
layers.selection: Locked Next/React/FastAPI/PostgreSQL fixture; platform-specific container and MCP tools only as needed.
layers.activation: Select the target host recipe, explicit service owner and isolated prefix; external hosting is a separate action.
layers.lifecycle_scope: Typed API/browser flows, migration reversal and rows after restart passed on named hosts; production auth and cloud deployment are unqualified.
layers.next_gap: Qualify independent database restore and production-specific access requirements before broader hosting claims.

layers.title: Recovery and portability
layers.purpose: Retain pinned inputs and prove usable restore, continuity and cleanup at the intended boundary.
layers.selection: Owned lifecycle recipes, Restic, native application backups and native session resume.
layers.activation: Use exact snapshots and empty restore targets; keep keys/account sign-ins private and separate from the checkout.
layers.lifecycle_scope: Same-host application restores, synthetic independent-host Restic recovery with a separately supplied password, and individual session/job continuations passed. Whole-stack independent-host disaster recovery has not.
layers.next_gap: Qualify affected application-state queries after off-host restore and the selected scheduled service after reboot.

layers.title: Observation and optional inference
layers.purpose: Observe bounded native outcomes and usage; trial local inference or routing only against a concrete gap.
layers.selection: Loopback native telemetry and scoped history; local model and gateway remain optional trials.
layers.activation: Preserve writer/task attribution, account boundaries and native default routes; dashboards do not grant operator authority.
layers.lifecycle_scope: Recorded telemetry reconciles scoped usage; HUD live rendering and exact-model gateway inference remain incomplete.
layers.next_gap: Resolve only the selected unknown attribution, interactive rendering or provider compatibility condition before retrying.

domain_boundary.scope: Historical execution engine and market-data assumptions belong to TRADING.
Broker/data SDK contract and observation acceptance belong to TRADING; no order authority is conveyed.
Only chronological financial splitter/control evidence is accepted; portfolio optimization is not a general foundation capability.
SEC acquisition and filing provenance belong to the financial data domain.
Current accepted use is financial/synthetic temporal materialization; a general SQL product claim requires its own workload acceptance.
Current accepted use is exact timestamp parsing and chronological financial controls, not blanket dataframe acceptance.
Pinned synthetic trading-engine replay belongs to TRADING; it does not establish historical equities or broker execution.

top_gaps.scope: General foundation capabilities now have an explicit home and scoped claims; the broad research union keeps its existing path.
top_gaps.next_action: Maintain these capability joins when a decision changes; do not migrate or adopt every discovery by directory placement.

top_gaps.scope: One native inherited-tool child completed cancellation, same-child continuation, abrupt parent-runtime failure, automatic systemd descendant cleanup and same-parent/same-child finalization with an unchanged checkpoint and one local effect. Prior manual-cleanup and permission-refused attempts remain retained; no host/provider/distributed guarantee is implied.
top_gaps.next_action: Reuse the accepted role and supervisor for matching tasks. Qualify changed application effects or host boundaries separately; do not rerun this fixture merely to refresh a green status.

top_gaps.scope: Synthetic independent-host Restic recovery passed with separately supplied fixture credentials. The second guest attempt automatically completed the native workload after reboot, but its required live serial observation failed; full scheduled-service acceptance and off-host application queries remain unqualified. Both failed attempts are retained.
top_gaps.next_action: Qualify the reviewed dedicated-serial observer correction, then native memory and Qdrant off-host queries at the selected adoption boundary.
